holding >= 1 doc):\n# Benign non-decoy:\n#   normal accesses ~ Poisson(0.9)\n#   after_hours accesses ~ Poisson(0.1 + framing_other_rate)\n#   where framing_other_rate = (1.0 / 38) [from Poisson(2)*0.5] + maybe (1/39 if random colleague DSL frame)\n#   Let's check empirical after_hours rate among known-innocent non-decoy (Legal+Research+Sales = 18 people)!\ninnocent_18 = [e[\"id\"] for e in employees if e[\"dept\"] in (\"Legal\", \"Research\", \"Sales\")]\nah_inn = sum(1 for d, emp, ah in logs if emp in innocent_18 and ah)\nnorm_inn = sum(1 for d, emp, ah in logs if emp in innocent_18 and not ah)\nprint(f\"18 known innocents across 5 days (90 emp-days): AH={ah_inn} ({ah_inn/90:.3f}/day), Norm={norm_inn} ({norm_inn/90:.3f}/day)\")\n\nah_decoy = sum(1 for d, emp, ah in logs if emp == \"e00\" and ah)\nnorm_decoy = sum(1 for d, emp, ah in logs if emp == \"e00\" and not ah)\nprint(f\"Decoy e00 across 5 days: AH={ah_decoy} ({ah_decoy/5:.2f}/day), Norm={norm_decoy} ({norm_decoy/5:.2f}/day)\")\n\n# Notice! For Mole:\n#   normal accesses ~ Poisson(0.7) per active day (4 days for Finance, 5 days for Eng)\n#   after_hours accesses ~ Poisson(0.3) per active day (ZERO framing goes to mole!)\n# For Benign non-decoy:\n#   normal accesses ~ Poisson(0.9) per active day\n#   after_hours accesses ~ Poisson(0.1 + 1.0/38) = Poisson(0.1263) per active day (or ~0.152 if DSL frames random colleague)\n# Let's compute log-likelihood ratio log(P(data | i is mole) / P(data | i is benign)) for each of the 21 suspects!\n\ndef pois_logpmf(k, lam):\n    return k * math.log(lam) - lam - math.lgamma(k + 1)\n\nscores = {}\nfor s in suspects:\n    dept = emp_map[s][\"dept\"]\n    active_days = [1,2,3,4,5] if dept == \"Engineering\" else [2,3,4,5]\n    ll_ratio = 0.0\n    ah_cnt = 0\n    norm_cnt = 0\n    for d in active_days:\n        ah = sum(1 for dd, emp, a in logs if dd == d and emp == s and a)\n        nm = sum(1 for dd, emp, a in logs if dd == d and emp == s and not a)\n        ah_cnt += ah\n        norm_cnt += nm\n        # Mole vs Benign (using lam_ah_benign = 0.135)\n        ll_mole = pois_logpmf(nm, 0.7) + pois_logpmf(ah, 0.3)\n        ll_ben  = pois_logpmf(nm, 0.9) + pois_logpmf(ah, 0.135)\n        ll_ratio += (ll_mole - ll_ben)\n    # Interviews\n    ev_cnt = sum(1 for emp, ev in interviews if emp == s and ev)\n    nev_cnt = sum(1 for emp, ev in interviews if emp == s and not ev)\n    ll_ratio += ev_cnt * math.log(0.24 / 0.20) + nev_cnt * math.log(0.76 / 0.80)\n    # Also note Day 1 no-leak slight bonus for Finance if mole was random (if DSL had day<=2 none, equal)\n    scores[s] = (ll_ratio, ah_cnt, norm_cnt, ev_cnt, nev_cnt)\n\ntot = sum(math.exp(v[0]) for v in scores.values())\nranked = sorted(suspects, key=lambda s: scores[s][0], reverse=True)\nprint(\"\\nSuspect ranking (21 suspects):\")\nfor s in ranked:\n    ll, ah, nm, ev, nev = scores[s]\n    prob = math.exp(ll) / tot\n    print(f\"  {s} ({emp_map[s]['dept']:11s}, cl={emp_map[s]['clearance']}): P={prob:.4f} | AH={ah}, Norm={nm} | Int={ev}/{ev+nev} evasive\")\n","filePath":"/tmp/opencode/tracker.py"},"output":"Wrote file successfully.","metadata":{"diagnostics":{},"filepath":"/tmp/opencode/tracker.py","exists":false,"truncated":false},"title":"tmp/opencode/tracker.py","time":{"start":1794716345507,"end":1794716345516}},"metadata":{"google":{"thoughtSignature":""}},"id":"prt_1dd6e2497001qBng9Dh8ACYCL3","sessionID":"ses_e229be561ffeiup5geI7IrMjYE","messageID":"msg_1dd6cd28d001XINADTh33i4AaN"}}

{"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1794716555864,"sessionID":"ses_e229be561ffeiup5geI7IrMjYE","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"write","callID":"fpFCdq32tjzkFDMf","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"filePath":"/tmp/opencode/design_c7.py","content":"import itertools, math, random\n\nfin = [\"e01\", \"e08\", \"e10\", \"e12\", \"e16\", \"e23\", \"e27\", \"e29\", \"e30\", \"e31\", \"e34\", \"e36\", \"e39\"]\nclearances = {\"e01\":2,\"e08\":2,\"e10\":2,\"e12\":2,\"e16\":3,\"e23\":3,\"e27\":2,\"e29\":1,\"e30\":2,\"e31\":1,\"e34\":2,\"e36\":3,\"e39\":1}\n\n# Previous canary assignments for Finance:\nc2 = {\"e01\":\"A\",\"e08\":\"A\",\"e10\":\"B\",\"e12\":\"B\",\"e16\":\"A\",\"e23\":\"B\",\"e27\":\"C\",\"e29\":\"A\",\"e30\":\"C\",\"e31\":\"B\",\"e34\":\"C\",\"e36\":\"C\",\"e39\":\"C\"}\nc6_1 = {\"e34\":\"A\",\"e08\":\"A\",\"e36\":\"A\",\"e39\":\"A\",\"e16\":\"B\",\"e23\":\"B\",\"e29\":\"B\",\"e31\":\"B\",\"e10\":\"C\",\"e27\":\"C\",\"e01\":\"C\",\"e30\":\"C\",\"e12\":\"C\"}\nc6_2 = {\"e34\":\"A\",\"e16\":\"A\",\"e23\":\"A\",\"e10\":\"A\",\"e08\":\"B\",\"e29\":\"B\",\"e27\":\"B\",\"e01\":\"B\",\"e30\":\"B\",\"e36\":\"C\",\"e39\":\"C\",\"e31\":\"C\",\"e12\":\"C\"}\n\n# Also check current suspect probabilities among the 13 Finance employees (Days 2-6 logs + interviews)\nlogs_fin = [\n    # Day 2\n    (2,\"e08\",True),(2,\"e08\",False),(2,\"e10\",False),(2,\"e16\",False),(2,\"e31\",False),(2,\"e31\",True),\n    (2,\"e34\",False),(2,\"e34\",False),(2,\"e36\",False),(2,\"e39\",False),(2,\"e39\",False),\n    # Day 3\n    (3,\"e08\",False),(3,\"e10\",False),(3,\"e10\",False),(3,\"e10\",False),(3,\"e12\",False),(3,\"e27\",False),\n    (3,\"e29\",False),(3,\"e29\",False),(3,\"e29\",False),(3,\"e29\",False),(3,\"e30\",False),(3,\"e36\",False),(3,\"e36\",False),\n    # Day 4\n    (4,\"e01\",False),(4,\"e08\",False),(4,\"e23\",False),(4,\"e23\",False),(4,\"e23\",False),(4,\"e29\",False),\n    (4,\"e31\",False),(4,\"e31\",False),(4,\"e31\",False),(4,\"e34\",False),(4,\"e34\",False),(4,\"e39\",False),\n    # Day 5\n    (5,\"e08\",False),(5,\"e08\",True),(5,\"e23\",False),(5,\"e30\",False),(5,\"e31\",False),(5,\"e31\",False),\n    (5,\"e31\",False),(5,\"e34\",False),(5,\"e36\",False),(5,\"e39\",False),\n    # Day 6\n    (6,\"e10\",False),(6,\"e27\",True),(6,\"e27\",True),(6,\"e29\",False),(6,\"e31\",False),(6,\"e31\",True),\n    (6,\"e34\",False),(6,\"e36\",False),\n]\ninterviews_fin = [\n    (\"e01\", False), (\"e08\", False), (\"e31\", False), (\"e08\", False), (\"e12\", False), (\"e16\", False)\n]\n\ndef pois_logpmf(k, lam):\n    return k * math.log(lam) - lam - math.lgamma(k + 1)\n\nprobs = {}\nfor s in fin:\n    ll = 0.0\n    ah_tot = 0\n    nm_tot = 0\n    for d in [2,3,4,5,6]:\n        ah = sum(1 for dd, emp, a in logs_fin if dd == d and emp == s and a)\n        nm = sum(1 for dd, emp, a in logs_fin if dd == d and emp == s and not a)\n        ah_tot += ah\n        nm_tot += nm\n        ll += (pois_logpmf(nm, 0.7) + pois_logpmf(ah, 0.3)) - (pois_logpmf(nm, 0.9) + pois_logpmf(ah, 0.14))\n    ev = sum(1 for emp, e in interviews_fin if emp == s and e)\n    nev = sum(1 for emp, e in interviews_fin if emp == s and not e)\n    ll += ev * math.log(0.24/0.20) + nev * math.log(0.76/0.80)\n    probs[s] = (ll, ah_tot, nm_tot, ev, nev)\n\ntot = sum(math.exp(v[0]) for v in probs.values())\nfor s in sorted(fin, key=lambda x: probs[x][0], reverse=True):\n    ll, ah, nm, ev, nev = probs[s]\n    p = math.exp(ll)/tot\n    probs[s] = p\n    print(f\"  {s} (cl={clearances[s]}): P={p:.4f} | AH={ah}, Norm={nm} | Int={ev}/{ev+nev} | c6=({c6_1[s]},{c6_2[s]})\")\n\n# Optimize c7_1 and c7_2 over fin (balanced 4,4,5 each) to minimize expected collision across ANY pair of canaries from {c6_1, c6_2, c7_1, c7_2}\nrandom.seed(42)\nlabels_base = [\"A\"]*4 + [\"B\"]*4 + [\"C\"]*5\nbest_score = 1e9\nbest_pair = None\n\nfor _ in range(50000):\n    l1 = labels_base[:]\n    l2 = labels_base[:]\n    random.shuffle(l1)\n    random.shuffle(l2)\n    m1 = dict(zip(fin, l1))\n    m2 = dict(zip(fin, l2))\n    # Evaluate collisions across all 6 pairs of {c6_1, c6_2, m1, m2}, weighted more heavily on (m1, m2) and cross pairs with m1, m2\n    canaries = [c6_1, c6_2, m1, m2]\n    weights = {(2,3): 3.0, (0,2): 2.0, (0,3): 2.0, (1,2): 2.0, (1,3): 2.0}\n    cost = 0.0\n    # Also penalize any two employees having >= 2 matches across the 4 canaries\n    for i in range(len(fin)):\n        for j in range(i+1, len(fin)):\n            u, v = fin[i], fin[j]\n            pw = probs[u] * probs[v]\n            same4 = sum(1 for c in canaries if c[u] == c[v])\n            if same4 >= 3:\n                cost += 1000 * pw + 10\n            elif same4 == 2:\n                cost += 50 * pw + 0.5\n            for (a, b), w in weights.items():\n                if canaries[a][u] == canaries[a][v] and canaries[b][u] == canaries[b][v]:\n                    cost += w * (10 * pw + 0.1)\n    if cost < best_score:\n        best_score = cost\n        best_pair = (m1, m2)\n\nm1, m2 = best_pair\nprint(\"\\nBest c7_1, c7_2 score:\", best_score)\nprint(\"c7_1:\", m1)\nprint(\"c7_2:\", m2)\nfor s in sorted(fin, key=lambda x: probs[x], reverse=True):\n    print(f\"  {s} (P={probs[s]:.3f}): ({c6_1[s]}, {c6_2[s]}, {m1[s]}, {m2[s]})\")\n"},"output":"Wrote file successfully.","metadata":{"diagnostics":{},"filepath":"/tmp/opencode/design_c7.py","exists":false,"truncated":false},"title":"tmp/opencode/design_c7.py","time":{"start":1794716555844,"end":1794716555861}},"metadata":{"google":{"thoughtSignature":""}},"id":"prt_1dd715a370016coormnxMvNEXc","sessionID":"ses_e229be561ffeiup5geI7IrMjYE","messageID":"msg_1dd70958d001IAPCKGuWjsMoQ6"}}

{"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1794716807153,"sessionID":"ses_e229be561ffeiup5geI7IrMjYE","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"write","callID":"eX1qwmCyISIryhYG","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"filePath":"/tmp/opencode/day10_bayes.py","content":"import math\n\nfin = [\"e01\", \"e08\", \"e10\", \"e12\", \"e16\", \"e23\", \"e27\", \"e29\", \"e30\", \"e31\", \"e34\", \"e36\", \"e39\"]\nc6_1 = {\"e34\":\"A\",\"e08\":\"A\",\"e36\":\"A\",\"e39\":\"A\",\"e16\":\"B\",\"e23\":\"B\",\"e29\":\"B\",\"e31\":\"B\",\"e10\":\"C\",\"e27\":\"C\",\"e01\":\"C\",\"e30\":\"C\",\"e12\":\"C\"}\nc6_2 = {\"e34\":\"A\",\"e16\":\"A\",\"e23\":\"A\",\"e10\":\"A\",\"e08\":\"B\",\"e29\":\"B\",\"e27\":\"B\",\"e01\":\"B\",\"e30\":\"B\",\"e36\":\"C\",\"e39\":\"C\",\"e31\":\"C\",\"e12\":\"C\"}\nc7_1 = {'e01': 'C', 'e08': 'C', 'e10': 'A', 'e12': 'C', 'e16': 'C', 'e23': 'B', 'e27': 'B', 'e29': 'B', 'e30': 'A', 'e31': 'A', 'e34': 'C', 'e36': 'A', 'e39': 'B'}\nc7_2 = {'e01': 'C', 'e08': 'B', 'e10': 'C', 'e12': 'A', 'e16': 'B', 'e23': 'A', 'e27': 'B', 'e29': 'C', 'e30': 'A', 'e31': 'B', 'e34': 'C', 'e36': 'C', 'e39': 'A'}\n\n# Logs for Finance across Days 2..9\nlogs_fin = [\n    # Day 2\n    (2,\"e08\",True),(2,\"e08\",False),(2,\"e10\",False),(2,\"e16\",False),(2,\"e31\",False),(2,\"e31\",True),\n    (2,\"e34\",False),(2,\"e34\",False),(2,\"e36\",False),(2,\"e39\",False),(2,\"e39\",False),\n    # Day 3\n    (3,\"e08\",False),(3,\"e10\",False),(3,\"e10\",False),(3,\"e10\",False),(3,\"e12\",False),(3,\"e27\",False),\n    (3,\"e29\",False),(3,\"e29\",False),(3,\"e29\",False),(3,\"e29\",False),(3,\"e30\",False),(3,\"e36\",False),(3,\"e36\",False),\n    # Day 4\n    (4,\"e01\",False),(4,\"e08\",False),(4,\"e23\",False),(4,\"e23\",False),(4,\"e23\",False),(4,\"e29\",False),\n    (4,\"e31\",False),(4,\"e31\",False),(4,\"e31\",False),(4,\"e34\",False),(4,\"e34\",False),(4,\"e39\",False),\n    # Day 5\n    (5,\"e08\",False),(5,\"e08\",True),(5,\"e23\",False),(5,\"e30\",False),(5,\"e31\",False),(5,\"e31\",False),\n    (5,\"e31\",False),(5,\"e34\",False),(5,\"e36\",False),(5,\"e39\",False),\n    # Day 6\n    (6,\"e10\",False),(6,\"e27\",True),(6,\"e27\",True),(6,\"e29\",False),(6,\"e31\",False),(6,\"e31\",True),\n    (6,\"e34\",False),(6,\"e36\",False),\n    # Day 7\n    (7,\"e01\",False),(7,\"e01\",False),(7,\"e01\",False),(7,\"e08\",False),(7,\"e10\",False),(7,\"e23\",False),\n    (7,\"e23\",False),(7,\"e29\",False),(7,\"e29\",False),(7,\"e30\",True),(7,\"e34\",False),(7,\"e34\",False),\n    (7,\"e39\",False),(7,\"e39\",False),\n    # Day 8\n    (8,\"e01\",True),(8,\"e01\",True),(8,\"e01\",False),(8,\"e08\",False),(8,\"e12\",False),(8,\"e16\",False),\n    (8,\"e16\",False),(8,\"e23\",False),(8,\"e27\",False),(8,\"e27\",False),(8,\"e30\",False),(8,\"e31\",False),(8,\"e39\",False),\n    # Day 9\n    (9,\"e01\",True),(9,\"e08\",False),(9,\"e08\",False),(9,\"e08\",False),(9,\"e10\",False),(9,\"e12\",False),\n    (9,\"e23\",False),(9,\"e29\",False),(9,\"e30\",False),(9,\"e31\",False),(9,\"e31\",False),(9,\"e36\",False),\n]\n\ninterviews_fin = [\n    (\"e01\", False), (\"e08\", False), (\"e31\", False), (\"e08\", False), (\"e12\", False), (\"e16\", False),\n    (\"e27\", False), (\"e27\", False), (\"e30\", False), (\"e31\", True),\n    (\"e08\", True), (\"e31\", False), (\"e01\", False), (\"e12\", False), (\"e16\", False), (\"e39\", False), (\"e23\", False),\n    (\"e01\", False), (\"e01\", False), (\"e27\", False), (\"e08\", True), (\"e30\", False), (\"e10\", False),\n]\n\ndef pois_logpmf(k, lam):\n    return k * math.log(lam) - lam - math.lgamma(k + 1)\n\n# Note on framing rate for benign non-decoy:\n# Poisson(2.0)*0.5 / 38 = 1.0/38 = 0.0263/day. Plus real AH = 0.10/day -> 0.1263/day!\n# Wait: earlier we saw 15 AH across 90 emp-days for 18 innocents = 0.167/day (maybe DSL frames random colleague +1/39 = 0.0256 -> 0.152/day).\n# Let's check both lam_ah_benign = 0.1263 and 0.152!\nfor lam_ah_ben in [0.1263, 0.152]:\n    print(f\"=== lam_ah_benign = {lam_ah_ben} ===\")\n    res = {}\n    for s in fin:\n        ll = 0.0\n        ah_tot = 0\n        nm_tot = 0\n        for d in range(2, 10):\n            ah = sum(1 for dd, emp, a in logs_fin if dd == d and emp == s and a)\n            nm = sum(1 for dd, emp, a in logs_fin if dd == d and emp == s and not a)\n            ah_tot += ah\n            nm_tot += nm\n            ll += (pois_logpmf(nm, 0.7) + pois_logpmf(ah, 0.3)) - (pois_logpmf(nm, 0.9) + pois_logpmf(ah, lam_ah_ben))\n        ev = sum(1 for emp, e in interviews_fin if emp == s and e)\n        nev = sum(1 for emp, e in interviews_fin if emp == s and not e)\n        ll += ev * math.log(0.24/0.20) + nev * math.log(0.76/0.80)\n        # Canary c7_1 leaked variant \"C\": P=0.95 if c7_1[s]==\"C\", else 0.025\n        ll += math.log(0.95 if c7_1[s] == \"C\" else 0.025)\n        res[s] = (ll, ah_tot, nm_tot, ev, nev)\n    tot = sum(math.exp(v[0]) for v in res.values())\n    for s in sorted(fin, key=lambda x: res[x][0], reverse=True):\n        ll, ah, nm, ev, nev = res[s]\n        p = math.exp(ll)/tot\n        print(f\"  {s}: P={p:.4f} | c7_1={c7_1[s]}, c6=({c6_1[s]},{c6_2[s]}), c7_2={c7_2[s]} | AH={ah}, Norm={nm} | Int={ev}/{ev+nev}\")\n"},"output":"Wrote file successfully.","metadata":{"diagnostics":{},"filepath":"/tmp/opencode/day10_bayes.py","exists":false,"truncated":false},"title":"tmp/opencode/day10_bayes.py","time":{"start":1794716807146,"end":1794716807152}},"metadata":{"google":{"thoughtSignature":""}},"id":"prt_1dd752fe5001AfJRh1OQBKJUZ0","sessionID":"ses_e229be561ffeiup5geI7IrMjYE","messageID":"msg_1dd74c90b0015jKuKZQVNbNZC5"}}

{"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1794717083492,"sessionID":"ses_e229be561ffeiup5geI7IrMjYE","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"write","callID":"FpPF9zwXjVj7gIRV","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"content":"import math\n\ncand = [\"e01\", \"e08\", \"e12\", \"e16\", \"e27\", \"e34\"]\nc7_1  = {'e01':'C','e08':'C','e12':'C','e16':'C','e27':'B','e34':'C'}\nc10_2 = {'e01':'A','e08':'B','e12':'B','e16':'C','e27':'A','e34':'C'}\n\n# Exact AH and Norm counts across active days 2..12 (11 days) for the 6 candidates:\n# Let's tally from all logs Days 2..12:\nah_counts   = {'e01': 4, 'e08': 2, 'e12': 0, 'e16': 0, 'e27': 2, 'e34': 1}\nnorm_counts = {'e01': 7, 'e08': 9, 'e12': 7, 'e16': 8, 'e27': 5, 'e34': 11}\nev_counts   = {'e01': (1,8), 'e08': (3,4), 'e12': (2,4), 'e16': (0,5), 'e27': (0,3), 'e34': (0,3)}\n\ndef pois_logpmf(k, lam):\n    return k * math.log(lam) - lam - math.lgamma(k + 1)\n\n# Note: sum of 11 independent Poissons(lam) has sufficient statistic sum(k) ~ Poisson(11*lam)!\nfor lam_ah_ben in [0.1263, 0.152]:\n    res = {}\n    for s in cand:\n        ah = ah_counts[s]\n        nm = norm_counts[s]\n        ev, nev = ev_counts[s]\n        ll = (pois_logpmf(nm, 11*0.7) + pois_logpmf(ah, 11*0.3)) - (pois_logpmf(nm, 11*0.9) + pois_logpmf(ah, 11*lam_ah_ben))\n        ll += ev * math.log(0.24/0.20) + nev * math.log(0.76/0.80)\n        ll += math.log(0.95 if c7_1[s] == 'C' else 0.025)\n        ll += math.log(0.95 if c10_2[s] == 'A' else 0.025)\n        res[s] = ll\n    tot = sum(math.exp(v) for v in res.values())\n    print(f\"=== lam_ah_benign = {lam_ah_ben} ===\")\n    for s in sorted(cand, key=lambda x: res[x], reverse=True):\n        print(f\"  {s}: P = {math.exp(res[s])/tot:.6f}\")\n","filePath":"/tmp/opencode/final_check.py"},"output":"Wrote file successfully.","metadata":{"diagnostics":{},"filepath":"/tmp/opencode/final_check.py","exists":false,"truncated":false},"title":"tmp/opencode/final_check.py","time":{"start":1794717083428,"end":1794717083487}},"metadata":{"google":{"thoughtSignature":""}},"id":"prt_1dd7966fd001eNQX6KdXM17Ipn","sessionID":"ses_e229be561ffeiup5geI7IrMjYE","messageID":"msg_1dd78f2020019SoRjFLkBYeiKC"}}
